usedFor: A line written in a Slack channel becomes a social post in Eclincher.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Post” in Eclincher
bestTemplate.why: It turns a line written in a channel into a social post, optionally scheduled.

watchOut: Anything in the channel can become a public post, and posts to public accounts wait for approval.
